body:
## Parent

https://github.com/Piyushmanyata/snp-camps/issues/41

## What to build

A doctor's screen with one thing on it: the patient in front of them, and one button that says they are done.

## Decisions already made — do not re-decide these

1. **The whole interaction is: scan or type a number → read the patient's details → press one full-width button → back to the scanner.**
2. **No confirmation dialog.** The doctor is looking at the patient's name on screen as they press the button. A confirm step doubles the taps in a loop that runs once per patient all day, and buys almost nothing.
3. **The button is full-width and large** — the largest tap target on the screen. A doctor should not have to aim.
4. **After marking seen, return immediately to the scanner**, ready for the next patient. No success screen, no "what next" menu. A brief inline confirmation is fine; a screen the doctor must dismiss is not.
5. **Patient details render read-only.** The doctor edits nothing.
6. **The registration-number field is available here too**, of equal weight to the scanner, per the scanner ticket. A doctor is never blocked by a camera.
7. **Re-scanning a `seen` patient stays blocked** with the existing message shape ("Already seen by Dr X"). Unchanged behaviour.
8. **The doctor is recorded on the patient when marked seen.** Unchanged behaviour.

## Accepted risk — recorded deliberately, do not "fix" it

9. `seen` is permanent and re-scanning a seen patient is blocked forever. With no confirmation dialog, a mis-tap marks the wrong patient seen and leaves them **unreachable in the system with no in-app recovery path.**

   This was weighed against adding an admin-side undo and **speed was chosen deliberately**. An undo is **out of scope for this ticket and for spec #41** — it is recorded as an open question on the spec. Do not add one. Do not add a confirmation dialog to compensate. If a real camp day produces this failure, it becomes its own ticket with real evidence behind it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The doctor flow is scan-or-type → read-only details → one full-width button → back to the scanner
- [ ] No confirmation dialog exists on the seen action
- [ ] The button is the largest tap target on the screen and is full-width
- [ ] After marking seen, the scanner is immediately ready with no screen to dismiss — asserted by e2e
- [ ] Re-scanning a `seen` patient is refused with the existing message shape — asserted by test
- [ ] The attending doctor is recorded on the patient — asserted by test
- [ ] The registration-number path reaches the same result as the scan path — asserted by test
- [ ] Doctor Station labels remain in English (Hinglish is the Volunteer Desk only)
- [ ] The `/doctor` route budget is lowered to the new measured size

## Blocked by

- #46 — two-round lifecycle (`waiting → seen` transition)
- #49 — scanner replacement (this screen uses the new scanner and number field)

## Skills to use

`ponytail` (mandatory — this screen should end up smaller than it started), `vercel-react-best-practices`, `tdd`, `check-work` before closing.

## Closing evidence required

Per `README.md`: literal `npm run verify` output, literal `npm run test:e2e` output or a named environment blocker, a statement of what coverage was removed, and the updated route budget.

## Closed — Doctor Station (#50)

**Commit:** bb27a4d

### What shipped
- Doctor flow: scan or type reg number → read-only details → full-width **Mark seen** → immediately back to scanner (toast only, no success card to dismiss)
- No confirmation dialog
- Re-scan of seen still blocked with existing message shape ("Already seen…")
- Doctor recorded via existing `assign_patient_doctor` (self-assign when role=doctor)
- English labels only
- Slimmer doctor page chrome; "Patients you saw" collapsed by default

### Acceptance
- [x] scan-or-type → details → one full-width button → back to scanner
- [x] No confirmation dialog
- [x] Button is largest full-width target (`size="lg"`)
- [x] After mark seen, scanner ready — e2e asserted
- [x] Re-scan seen refused — e2e asserted
- [x] Attending doctor recorded (existing RPC + unit success predicate)
- [x] Reg-number path same as scan path (same lookup/assign entry points)
- [x] English labels
- [x] `/doctor` budget: measured gzip 447231 → `budgetFromMeasured` = 461000 (unchanged ceiling; no room to lower without tightening below formula)

### Coverage
- **No coverage removed.**
- Added: unit wiring test for Mark seen / no confirm copy; e2e mark-seen + already-seen; dedicated E2E doctor patient fixture.

### Evidence

**npm run verify** — exit 0
- lint: pass
- unit: 136/136 pass
- build: pass
- check:js-budget: all routes ok (`/doctor` actual=447231 budget=461000)

**npm run test:e2e** — exit 0
- 14 passed (47.6s) including `doctor mark seen returns to scanner with no dismiss screen`
